entries.title: Job 17:1
segments: ¶My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are mine.

entries.title: Job 17:2
segments: Are there not mockers around me? and doth [not] mine eye abide in their provocation?

entries.title: Job 17:3
segments: Lay down now [a pledge], be thou surety for me with thyself: who is he that striketh hands with me?

entries.title: Job 17:4
segments: For thou hast hidden their heart from understanding; therefore thou wilt not exalt [them].

entries.title: Job 17:5
segments: He that betrayeth friends for a prey--even the eyes of his children shall fail.

entries.title: Job 17:6
segments: And he hath made me a proverb of the peoples; and I am become one to be spit on in the face.

entries.title: Job 17:7
segments: And mine eye is dim by reason of grief, and all my members are as a shadow.

entries.title: Job 17:8
segments: Upright men [shall be] astonished at this, and the innocent shall be stirred up against the ungodly;

entries.title: Job 17:9
segments: But the righteous shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall increase in strength.

entries.title: Job 17:10
segments: ¶But as for you all, pray come on again; and I shall not find one wise man among you.

entries.title: Job 17:11
segments: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, the cherished thoughts of my heart.

entries.title: Job 17:12
segments: They change the night into day; the light [they imagine] near in presence of the darkness.

entries.title: Job 17:13
segments: If I wait, Sheol is my house; I spread my bed in the darkness:

entries.title: Job 17:14
segments: I cry to the grave, Thou art my father! to the worm, My mother, and my sister!

entries.title: Job 17:15
segments: And where is then my hope? yea, my hope, who shall see it?

entries.title: Job 17:16
segments: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, when [our] rest shall be together in the dust.
